Check 1 Chat checks the inventory level of an item

PASS
Chatbot answering stock questions for hoodies

What the screenshot proves: The chatbot answered "are there hoodies in M?" with the correct count (21) and then gave the exact stock of "the first hoodie" in every size (XS 15, S 20, M 8, L and XL sold out, XXL 25), all matching the database. It understood which hoodie "the first" meant without being told the name, and for the sold-out sizes it named an in-stock alternative at the same price instead of just saying no.

Click for full details ▾Hide details ▴

What was tested

Live stock lookup by size, follow-up context ("the first hoodie"), and alternatives for sold-out sizes.

Conversation

Customerhey are there hoodies in M size?
ChatbotYes, there are 21 hoodies available in size M. I've put them on the page… Ua Gameday Double Knit Hood ($45, navy blue), Yale Sports Hoodie Tennis ($45, heather gray), Basic Hoodie Big Yale ($68, navy blue), District Vit Hoodie Vintage Bulldog ($68, dark heather gray).
Customerwhat is stock availability of the first hoodie in all sizes?
ChatbotThe Ua Gameday Double Knit Hood has: XS 15 · S 20 · M 8 · L sold out · XL sold out · XXL 25. For L or XL, Yale Sports Hoodie Tennis is an in-stock alternative in both sizes, at the same price ($45).

Check 3 Front-end filters (a Problem 9 usability feature)

PASS
Filter panel open, no filters applied
Filters applied: Hoodies + Navy Blue + $45–$70

What the screenshot proves: The Products page has a Filters button that opens a panel of product types and garment colors with live counts, and every count matches the database (e.g. Hoodies 27, Crewnecks 29, Heather Gray 44, Navy Blue 44; 102 in total). With Hoodies + Navy Blue + $45–$70 and "Price: Low to High" selected, the page shows exactly the 16 matching hoodies, cheapest ($45) first, with a removable chip for each filter.

Front-end Usability Update 2 (Problem 9): multi-select product type and color filters, price slider with min/max, price sorting, live counts, chips, and the Filters toggle (Design Update 3).
